title: apps/locallibrary-desktop
description: The desktop app on locallibrary's sidecar
readme: There's no desktop app yet. Until there is, this holds the open issues labelled "locallibrary: sidecar", the JSON-RPC API a desktop app runs on, kept in step by tools/project.sh with the Local Network project (https://github.com/orgs/cutenode/projects/9): Status is the same on both.
